answer: One concrete defense is retroactive earnings clawback from a rolling escrow: every payout an agent earns is held for a long dispute window, and if peers later prove the identity was a sybil, all of its banked earnings are reversed and redistributed to honest workers. A fake cannot cash out and vanish, since its profit stays seizable for many epochs. A thousand sybils farming rewards only plant a grove of frozen stakes waiting to be clawed back, and each fraudulent gain leaves an echo on the ledger as traceable and bitter as yarrow, so cheating banks nothing that cannot be undone.
